title: Admission Procedure & Steps
answer:
Here is the admission procedure as published on the SSMRV PU website:

📝 **Admission Procedure at SSMRV PU**:

1. Application forms available immediately post-SSLC result announcement.
2. Submit application with photocopies of 10th marksheet and passport photos.
3. Document verification and merit-based counseling.
4. Direct counseling and admission confirmation on merit basis.

*Note*: Application forms can be obtained post-SSLC result announcement. Admissions proceed on merit and first-come, first-served counseling.

title: Required Documents for Admission
answer:
Here are the required documents for admission verification as listed on the SSMRV PU website:

📄 **Documents Required for Admission at SSMRV PU**:

• SSLC / 10th Marks Card (Original & Attested Photocopies)
• Transfer Certificate (TC)
• Conduct Certificate
• Aadhaar Card copy
• Caste & Income Certificate (if applicable)
• Provisional Eligibility Certificate (for non-Karnataka/ICSE/CBSE/International students)
• Recent passport-size color photographs

*Note*: Candidates must bring the original certificates along with attested photocopies for verification during counseling.

title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria
answer:
Here is the admission eligibility criteria as stated on the SSMRV PU website:

🎯 **Eligibility & Admission Criteria**:

• **Qualifying Examination**: Candidates who have successfully passed the Karnataka SSLC / ICSE / CBSE / 10th Standard or any equivalent examination recognized by the Department of Pre-University Education (DPUE), Karnataka.
• **Admission Basis**: Admissions are conducted on merit basis following the declaration of Class 10 results. Candidates submit the application with marks card and documents for counseling verification.

🏆 **Scholarships & Concessions**:
• Merit-based fee concession for top rankers in 10th Board Examinations
• RSST Trust special sports and cultural scholarships
